sentences.en: The story begins in the year 2000 with a flower seller named Enver Şimşek.
sentences.zh: 故事始于2000年，主角是一位名叫恩维尔·希姆谢克的卖花商。

sentences.en: Enver's 38 years old.
sentences.zh: 恩维尔当时38岁。

sentences.en: He moved to Germany with his wife back in 1985 from Turkey, like more than 2 million other Turkish immigrants who came here in the decades after the war.
sentences.zh: 他于1985年和妻子从土耳其移居德国，就像战后几十年里来到这里的200多万其他土耳其移民一样。

sentences.en: He and his wife had two kids, a son and a daughter, both born in Germany.
sentences.zh: 他和妻子有两个孩子，一儿一女，都是在德国出生的。

sentences.en: He started out working in a factory, long hours.
sentences.zh: 他起初在工厂工作，工作时间很长。

sentences.en: But in his free time, he sold flowers.
sentences.zh: 但在空闲时间，他会卖花。

sentences.en: And eventually, he quit his job in the factory to work in flowers full-time.
sentences.zh: 最终，他辞去了工厂的工作，全职卖花。

sentences.en: One September morning, Enver leaves his hometown near
sentences.zh: 九月的一个早晨，恩维尔离开了他家乡附近的

sentences.en: Frankfurt and drives a couple of hours east to Nuremberg to stand in for another flower seller who was out of town.
sentences.zh: 法兰克福，开车向东行驶了几个小时来到纽伦堡，替一位出差的卖花商看摊。

sentences.en: Just before 9 a.m., he parks his van along the side of a suburban road and sets up shop.
sentences.zh: 上午9点前，他把货车停在郊区路边，摆好了摊位。

sentences.en: And around midday, he's shot multiple times in his head and in his cheSt. He dies two days later.
sentences.zh: 中午时分，他的头部和胸部中弹多次。两天后他去世了。

sentences.en: Police begin investigating.
sentences.zh: 警方开始调查。

sentences.en: And very quickly, they come up with a theory.
sentences.zh: 很快，他们就提出了一个理论。

sentences.en: That Enver, who would drive to the Netherlands every week to get flowers, was transporting drugs.
sentences.zh: 他们认为每周都要开车去荷兰进货的恩维尔是在运送毒品。

sentences.en: And even though they find no traces of drugs in his van, they cling on to the theory that Enver was involved in some kind of drug ring.
sentences.zh: 尽管他们在他的货车里没有发现任何毒品痕迹，但他们仍坚持认为恩维尔卷入了某种贩毒集团。

sentences.en: The case goes nowhere.
sentences.zh: 案件陷入了僵局。

sentences.en: And then, nine months later, another Turkish immigrant is killed.
sentences.zh: 九个月后，又有一名土耳其移民被杀。

sentences.en: Abdurahim Özudoru's body is discovered at his tailor shop, not far from where Enver was killed.
sentences.zh: 阿卜杜拉希姆·厄祖多鲁的尸体在他的裁缝店被发现，距离恩维尔遇害的地方不远。

sentences.en: Police are quick to identify the murder weapon as the same one that killed Enver.
sentences.zh: 警方很快认定凶器与杀害恩维尔的是同一把。

sentences.en: A rare Ceska 83 handgun.
sentences.zh: 一把罕见的捷克 CZ 83 手枪。

sentences.en: Two weeks after that, there's another murderer.
sentences.zh: 两周后，又发生了一起谋杀案。

sentences.en: Suleyman Tashkopru, a produce seller, is killed in his father's shop in Hamburg.
sentences.zh: 农产品商苏莱曼·塔什科普鲁在汉堡他父亲的店里被杀。

sentences.en: Same gun.
sentences.zh: 还是那把枪。

sentences.en: Another two months later, a Turkish grocer named Habil Külüç is killed in Munich.
sentences.zh: 又过了两个月，一位名叫哈比勒·屈吕奇的土耳其杂货商在慕尼黑被杀。

sentences.en: Same gun.
sentences.zh: 还是那把枪。

sentences.en: The families of the victims tell police that maybe this is a series of hate crimes.
sentences.zh: 受害者家属告诉警方，这可能是一系列仇恨犯罪。

sentences.en: Maybe investigators should look to the far right.
sentences.zh: 也许调查人员应该关注一下极右翼。

sentences.en: But police continue to suspect it has to do with drugs.
sentences.zh: 但警方继续怀疑这与毒品有关。

sentences.en: Immigrants killing other immigrants, like some kind of Turkish mafia.
sentences.zh: 移民杀害移民，就像某种土耳其黑手党一样。

sentences.en: And still, the case goes nowhere.
sentences.zh: 案件依然毫无进展。

sentences.zh: 然后，在2004年，又发生了一起谋杀案。

sentences.zh: 接着是慕尼黑的

sentences.en: Mehmet Kubasik in Dortmund.
sentences.zh: 多特蒙德的穆罕默德·库巴西克。

sentences.en: Halit Yaskat, an owner of an internet cafe in Kassel.
sentences.zh: 卡塞尔一家网吧的老板哈利特·亚斯卡特。

sentences.en: All the victims have an immigrant background.
sentences.zh: 所有受害者都有移民背景。

sentences.en: All are shot in the head.
sentences.zh: 所有人都是头部中弹。

sentences.en: All with a Czeska 83.
sentences.zh: 用的都是捷克 CZ 83。

sentences.en: And even though witnesses at multiple murder scenes report seeing white men who look like Nazis, the police stick to their theory of a Turkish mafia.
sentences.zh: 尽管多起谋杀现场的目击者报告说看到了看起来像纳粹的白人男子，但警方仍坚持他们的土耳其黑手党理论。

sentences.en: And the murders come to be known as the kebab murders.
sentences.zh: 这些谋杀案后来被称为“烤肉店谋杀案”。

sentences.en: For years, they go unsolved.
sentences.zh: 多年来，它们一直未被侦破。

sentences.en: Until one day, in 2011, when two masked men charge into a bank in an eastern German town.
sentences.zh: 直到2011年的一天，两名蒙面男子冲进德国东部一个小镇的银行。

sentences.en: Both have guns, and they steal over 70,000 euros.
sentences.zh: 两人都持有枪支，抢走了超过7万欧元。

sentences.en: Then they run outside, get on bicycles, and flee the scene.
sentences.zh: 然后他们跑出银行，骑上自行车逃离了现场。

sentences.en: As they make their getaway, they pass an old man on the street who sees them shove their bikes into a camper van and then peel off.
sentences.zh: 在逃跑过程中，他们经过街上的一位老人，老人看到他们把自行车塞进一辆露营车，然后飞驰而去。

sentences.en: When the police pass that way looking for the robbers, the old man tells them what he saw.
sentences.zh: 当警察搜寻劫匪经过那里时，老人告诉了他们所见的情况。

sentences.en: Not long after, the police find the camper van.
sentences.zh: 不久之后，警方发现了那辆露营车。

sentences.en: And as they walk towards it, the door swings open, and two men open fire with a submachine gun.
sentences.zh: 当他们走向车时，车门突然打开，两名男子用冲锋枪开火。

sentences.en: But the gun jams, so they shut themselves back inside the camper van.
sentences.zh: 但枪卡壳了，于是他们把自己关回了露营车里。

sentences.en: The police hear two more shots.
sentences.zh: 警察又听到了两声枪响。

sentences.en: Moments later, the camper van goes up in flames,
sentences.zh: 片刻之后，露营车燃起了大火，

sentences.en: black smoke billowing from it.
sentences.zh: 黑烟滚滚而出。

sentences.en: Once the police open the door, they find several weapons.
sentences.zh: 当警察打开车门时，他们发现了多件武器。

sentences.en: And the burned bodies of the two men with gunshot wounds in their heads.
sentences.zh: 还有两名头部中弹的男子的烧焦尸体。

sentences.en: And as police are still securing the scene, there's an explosion at an apartment more than 100 miles away.
sentences.zh: 就在警方还在封锁现场时，100多英里外的一间公寓发生了爆炸。

sentences.en: The police get to that scene, and when the fire dies down, they start sifting through the rubble.
sentences.zh: 警方赶到现场，火势减弱后，他们开始在废墟中搜寻。

sentences.en: Eventually, they find a gun.
sentences.zh: 最终，他们找到了一把枪。

sentences.en: A Czeska 83.
sentences.zh: 一把捷克 CZ 83。

sentences.en: They also find dozens of copies of a DVD.
sentences.zh: 他们还发现了数十份 DVD 拷贝。

sentences.en: They're in envelopes, addressed to media and other organizations, with no return address.
sentences.zh: 它们装在信封里，寄给了媒体和其他机构，没有回信地址。

sentences.en: And when they press play, a bizarre cartoon plays out.
sentences.zh: 当他们按下播放键时，一段诡异的动画开始播放。

sentences.en: It's the Pink Panther.
sentences.zh: 是《粉红豹》。

sentences.en: He carries a stack of posters to an easel in a spotlight.
sentences.zh: 它带着一叠海报走到聚光灯下的画架前。

sentences.en: And he starts the kind of presentation.
sentences.zh: 然后它开始了某种演示。

sentences.en: On poster after poster, there's newspaper clippings of the nine immigrant murders that had never been solved, with photos of the victiMs.
sentences.zh: 在一张又一张海报上，贴着从未侦破的九起移民谋杀案的剪报，上面还有受害者的照片。

sentences.en: There's also the photo of a 10th victim, a police officer, whose death had never been linked to the other murders.
sentences.zh: 还有第十位受害者的照片，那是一名警察，他的死此前从未与这些谋杀案联系在一起。

sentences.en: And the video reveals who's responsible for it all.
sentences.zh: 视频揭示了这一切的幕后黑手。

sentences.en: It's a group of neo-Nazis, who took their name from Hitler's Nazi party.
sentences.zh: 这是一个新纳粹组织，他们以希特勒的纳粹党命名。

sentences.en: They call themselves the National Socialist Underground, the NSU.
sentences.zh: 他们自称为“国家社会主义地下党”，简称 NSU。

sentences.en: And they say their motto is actions, not words.
sentences.zh: 他们说他们的座右铭是“行动，而非言语”。

sentences.en: A few days after the botched bank robbery, a woman turns herself in.
sentences.zh: 在那次拙劣的银行抢劫案发生几天后，一名女子自首了。

sentences.en: Her name is Beate Cepel.
sentences.zh: 她的名字叫贝亚特·切佩。

sentences.en: Investigators had been looking for her for a long time.
sentences.zh: 调查人员已经寻找她很长时间了。

sentences.en: They knew her as part of a trio, along with two men, Uwe Mundlos and Uwe Bernhardt.
sentences.zh: 他们三人组成了一个团伙，另外两名成员是乌韦·蒙德洛斯和乌韦·伯恩哈特。

sentences.en: All three grew up in the former communist eaSt. They were teenagers when Germany reunified.
sentences.zh: 这三人都在前东德长大，德国统一时他们还是青少年。

sentences.zh: 他们判得太轻了。

sentences.en: Like Seda, federal prosecutors had hoped for far tougher sentences.
sentences.zh: 和塞达一样，联邦检察官原本也希望判得重得多。

sentences.en: And so it was a not good day for the German justice.
sentences.zh: 所以这对德国司法来说不是美好的一天。

sentences.en: Angela Merkel, she gives a promise to my clients.
sentences.zh: 安格拉·默克尔曾向我的当事人做出承诺。

sentences.en: She said that, I promised you that I will do everything to solve the NSU.
sentences.zh: 她说，我向你们保证，我会尽一切努力解决NSU的问题。

sentences.en: And my clients thought that when Angela Merkel says something like that, we can't trust her.
sentences.zh: 我的当事人认为，既然安格拉·默克尔都这么说了，我们应该可以相信她。

sentences.en: So now we know she didn't keep her promise.
sentences.zh: 但现在我们知道，她没有信守承诺。

sentences.en: There is no justice at the end of this case for our clients.
sentences.zh: 在这个案件的最后，我们的当事人没有得到正义。

sentences.en: Despite the promises of the government, multiple investigations, and her own attempts to unseal the NSU files,
sentences.zh: 尽管政府做出了承诺，进行了多次调查，她自己也曾试图解封NSU档案，

sentences.en: Seda never gets the answers she wanted.
sentences.zh: 但塞达始终没有得到她想要的答案。

sentences.en: So my clients ask me, why?
sentences.zh: 所以我的当事人问我，为什么？

sentences.en: Why is this such a problem?
sentences.zh: 为什么这会是个大问题？

sentences.en: Yeah?
sentences.zh: 是吗？

sentences.en: So we have so many questions.
sentences.zh: 我们有太多的疑问。

sentences.en: Who knew what at what point?
sentences.zh: 谁在什么时候知道了什么？

sentences.en: And they didn't give us the answers.
sentences.zh: 他们没有给我们答案。

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: Why do you think?
sentences.zh: 你觉得是为什么？

sentences.en: Because they are involved.
sentences.zh: 因为他们牵涉其中。

sentences.en: This is the only possible answer.
sentences.zh: 这是唯一可能的答案。

sentences.en: By the end of the trial, Seda's left in the same place as Stephen Kramer.
sentences.zh: 审判结束时，塞达的处境和斯蒂芬·克莱默一样。

sentences.en: She says she's come to believe that far-right extremism has infiltrated the very institutions that are supposed to protect against it.
sentences.zh: 她说她开始相信，极右翼极端主义已经渗透进了本应防范它的机构内部。

sentences.en: And that belief only intensifies three weeks after the trial.
sentences.zh: 而这种信念在审判结束三周后变得更加强烈。

sentences.en: I was at this time in Tunisia.
sentences.zh: 当时我正在突尼斯。

sentences.en: When she's traveling for another case.
sentences.zh: 那时她正因另一个案子在出差。

sentences.en: And I was in the late night in the hotel and I checked my emails and faxes and so.
sentences.zh: 深夜我在酒店里查看邮件、传真之类的东西。

sentences.en: But one fax was different.
sentences.zh: 但有一份传真很特别。

sentences.en: What did the fax say?
sentences.zh: 那份传真上写了什么？

sentences.en: Do you remember the words exactly?
sentences.zh: 你还记得具体内容吗？

sentences.en: You won't finish off Germany.
sentences.zh: 你毁不了德国。

sentences.en: You won't finish off Germany.
sentences.zh: 你毁不了德国。

sentences.en: We will slaughter your daughter.
sentences.zh: 我们要宰了你的女儿。

sentences.en: And we know your private address.
sentences.zh: 而且我们知道你的私人住址。

sentences.en: And at the end they say NSU 2.0.
sentences.zh: 最后他们写着NSU 2.0。

sentences.en: I'm not a hysteric person.
sentences.zh: 我不是个歇斯底里的人。

sentences.en: But I was in Tunisia and thousands of kilometers far away from my child.
sentences.zh: 但我当时在突尼斯，离我的孩子有几千公里远。

sentences.en: And so I think about it.
sentences.zh: 所以我开始思考。

sentences.en: How serious is this now?
sentences.zh: 这事现在有多严重？

sentences.en: Because this people, he has informations about me.
sentences.zh: 因为这些人，他掌握着关于我的信息。

sentences.en: So for me was the question, how they get this information from me?
sentences.zh: 所以对我来说，问题是，他们是怎么得到我的信息的？

sentences.en: How it is possible that they have my address and the name of my daughter?
sentences.zh: 他们怎么可能知道我的住址和我女儿的名字？

sentences.en: It's not publicly available.
sentences.zh: 这些信息并不是公开的。

sentences.en: And so I call the police.
sentences.zh: 于是我报了警。

sentences.en: Seda reports the threat.
sentences.zh: 塞达报告了威胁。

sentences.en: Flies home.
sentences.zh: 飞回了家。

sentences.en: An investigation gets underway.
sentences.zh: 调查随即展开。

sentences.en: A few months later.
sentences.zh: 几个月后。

sentences.en: So I was on the road again and I heard on the radio some police officers in Frankfurt are suspended.
sentences.zh: 当时我正在路上，在广播里听到法兰克福有一些警察被停职了。

sentences.en: Something on the news catches her attention.
sentences.zh: 新闻里的一些内容引起了她的注意。

sentences.en: There are some details and I think it can be my case.
sentences.zh: 有一些细节，我觉得可能和我的案子有关。

sentences.en: So I contact the police officer and say, Is something you want to tell me?
sentences.zh: 所以我联系了那位警官，问他：有什么想告诉我的吗？

sentences.en: Because I heard on the radio there are investigations against police officers.
sentences.zh: 因为我在广播里听到正在对警察进行调查。

sentences.en: Is this my case?
sentences.zh: 这和我的案子有关吗？

sentences.en: So he said, everything is okay.
sentences.zh: 他说，一切都好。

sentences.en: We investigate.
sentences.zh: 我们正在调查。

sentences.en: Two days later, a journalist write me an email about this suspended police officers in Frankfurt.
sentences.zh: 两天后，一位记者给我发了封邮件，提到法兰克福那些被停职的警察。

sentences.en: He wants to talk with me.
sentences.zh: 他想和我谈谈。

sentences.en: And so I call the police officer again.
sentences.zh: 于是我再次给那位警官打电话。

sentences.en: And say, he is a journaliSt.
sentences.zh: 我说，有位记者。

sentences.en: He wants to talk with me about this suspended officers.
sentences.zh: 他想和我谈谈这些被停职的警察。

sentences.en: Is something you want to tell me?
sentences.zh: 你有什么想告诉我的吗？

sentences.en: I ask you again.
sentences.zh: 我再问你一次。

sentences.en: And finally.
sentences.zh: 最后。

sentences.en: And he say, okay.
sentences.zh: 他说，好吧。

sentences.en: The police give her an answer.
sentences.zh: 警方给了她答复。

sentences.en: He came to my office and say, one hour before this fax sent to me, my address and the name of my daughter,
sentences.zh: 他来到我的办公室说，在那份传真发给我的一小时前，我的住址、我女儿的名字，

sentences.en: the name of my whole family, my parents and my husband, are accessed in the police computer in Frankfurt.
sentences.zh: 我全家人的名字，包括我父母和我丈夫的，都被人从法兰克福的警用电脑里查询过了。

sentences.en: Since NSU, I knew that there are some problems in our institutions in Germany.
sentences.zh: 自NSU案以来，我就知道德国的机构存在一些问题。

sentences.en: But for me, it was new that police officers maybe has something to do with threatening my two-year-old daughter.
sentences.zh: 但对我来说，警察可能参与威胁我两岁女儿这件事，还是头一次听说。

sentences.en: Seda learns that the officer who had been locked onto the computer when her private information was accessed was discovered to be part of a far-right WhatsApp group.
sentences.zh: 塞达得知，在她私人信息被查询时，登录该电脑的警官被发现是一个极右翼WhatsApp群组的成员。

sentences.en: The group shared neo-Nazi memes mocking drowned refugees and showing Hitler on a rainbow with the caption,
sentences.zh: 该群组分享嘲笑溺亡难民的新纳粹表情包，并展示希特勒坐在彩虹上的图片，配文是：

sentences.en: Good night, you Jews.
sentences.zh: 晚安，犹太人。

sentences.en: That officer and a handful of others in that group were suspended.
sentences.zh: 那名警官和群组里的其他几个人被停职了。

sentences.en: And the whole police station was searched.
sentences.zh: 整个警察局都受到了搜查。

sentences.en: So they suspended these police officers, But they did not prove that they are responsible for the fax.
sentences.zh: 他们停职了这些警察，但并没有证明他们就是发传真的人。

sentences.en: And the investigations
sentences.zh: 而调查

sentences.en: Dauern noch an?
sentences.zh: 还在继续？

sentences.zh: 还在继续。

sentences.zh: 还在继续。

sentences.en: Yes.

sentences.en: In the following months, they were investigated against 38 police officers.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几个月里，他们调查了38名警察。

sentences.en: The number of suspended officers grows to 38.
sentences.zh: 被停职的警察人数增加到了38人。

sentences.en: It's just one precinct.
sentences.zh: 这仅仅是一个分局。

sentences.en: I think if you have 38 persons, you have a structural problem.
sentences.zh: 我认为如果有38个人，那就是结构性问题了。

sentences.en: And it's not until May 3rd, 2021, nearly three years after Seda got that fax, that police arrest a man they believe was behind it,
sentences.zh: 直到2021年5月3日，也就是塞达收到那份传真近三年后，警方才逮捕了一名他们认为幕后主使的男子，

sentences.en: as well as 114 other messages, all signed NSU 2.0.
sentences.zh: 他同时还涉及其他114条信息，全部署名为NSU 2.0。

sentences.en: Police say he's never worked for them, that he was probably acting alone, a single case.
sentences.zh: 警方称他从未为他们工作过，他很可能是单独行动，是个案。

sentences.en: But how exactly he got access to information on police computers remains unclear.
sentences.zh: 但他究竟是如何获取警用电脑信息的，仍不清楚。

sentences.en: What is clear is that hundreds of officers across the country have come under investigation on suspicion of far-right extremism.
sentences.zh: 明确的是，全国已有数百名警察因涉嫌极右翼极端主义而受到调查。

sentences.en: It is the most important thing for the police in Germany.
sentences.zh: 这对德国警方来说是最重要的事情。

sentences.en: He has suspended a number of officers suspected of sharing extremist content in online chat groups.
sentences.zh: 他已经停职了多名涉嫌在在线聊天群中分享极端主义内容的警官。

sentences.en: Police officers in the German state of Norway were a failure.
sentences.zh: 德国北威州的警察是一次失败。

sentences.en: In one state, 31 officers were suspended for sharing images of a refugee in a gas chamber and the shooting of a black man.
sentences.zh: 在一个州，31名警察因分享难民在毒气室的图片以及黑人被枪杀的图片而被停职。

sentences.en: In chat groups, they sent themselves through NRW in the ministerium three members.
sentences.zh: 在聊天群里，他们通过北威州内政部发送这些内容。

sentences.en: In another, 25 officers were discovered to be in a racist chat group.
sentences.zh: 在另一个州，发现有25名警察身处一个种族主义聊天群中。

sentences.en: Nazi symbols such as swastikas.
sentences.zh: 里面有纳粹万字旗等符号。

sentences.en: Six cadets were kicked out from a police academy after playing down the Holocaust and posting swastikas online.
sentences.zh: 六名学员因淡化大屠杀并在网上发布万字旗而被警校开除。

sentences.en: I have long thought that these were only single incidents, but these are not single cases.
sentences.zh: 我长期以来一直认为这些只是个别事件，但这些并非个案。

sentences.en: Some officers were even found to be hoarding ammunition and Nazi memorabilia, just like Franco A.
sentences.zh: 一些警察甚至被发现囤积弹药和纳粹纪念品，就像佛朗哥·A那样。

sentences.en: and the network he was a part of.
sentences.zh: 以及他所属的网络。

sentences.en: And it's this kind of thing that investigators are worried about.
sentences.zh: 调查人员担心的正是这类事情。

sentences.en: More than threat letters celebrating the NSU name, they're worried about people actually plotting terrorism.
sentences.zh: 比起庆祝NSU名号的威胁信，他们更担心有人真的在策划恐怖袭击。

sentences.en: People who like the NSU are focused on actions, not words.
sentences.zh: 像NSU那样的人，他们关注的是行动，而不是言语。

sentences.en: We did not learn from this case.
sentences.zh: 我们没有从这个案件中吸取教训。

sentences.en: Nothing changes.
sentences.zh: 什么都没有改变。

sentences.en: Everything is the same.
sentences.zh: 一切照旧。

sentences.en: So now we have Franco A.
sentences.zh: 所以现在我们有了佛朗哥·A。

sentences.en: And so now SEDA sees another case the institutions missed.
sentences.zh: 现在塞达看到了另一个机构错失的案件。

sentences.en: And another trial.
sentences.zh: 以及另一场审判。

sentences.en: But this time, the defendant is an officer in the German military who's being accused of plotting an attack meant to take down the Federal Republic of Germany.
sentences.zh: 但这一次，被告是一名德国军官，他被指控策划旨在推翻德意志联邦共和国的袭击。
